caption.text:
Your agent makes the same mistake on Monday that it made on Friday.

Because nothing it learned was written down.

This one keeps a playbook.
Every wrong answer → one new bullet.

→ a Generator does the task
→ a Reflector compares it with the correct answer
→ a Curator adds the lesson. Never rewrites.
→ plain Python merges it, votes on it, prunes it

8 invoices it had never seen:
empty playbook 4/16. Its own 3-bullet playbook 16/16.

Swipe for the loop 👉
